card.name: Inside long drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through long drug names, on the middle or ending piece such as 'azole', 'eth', 'ax' or 'SON', just before the name finishes. Also seen in a few capitalized proper names like Nicaea.

modes.label: Drug name pieces
